reason: The implementer stopped only the D process after observing unexpectedly high CUDA reservation during engineering calibration/pilot; no A/B/C process was signalled.

reconstructed_observation.source: interactive tool transcript; this value was not written by the interrupted process

diagnosis: The excess was allocator reservation retained after full-dynamic gamma calibration, not growth in post-step live allocations.
resolution: The replacement candidate selects the three cheapest complete systems for calibration and releases unused phase caches before the bounded pilot.
recovery: The interrupted engineering run is not resumable and is prohibited as a formal parent.
